name: Barbell Incline Bench Press
steps: Set the bench to a moderate incline, lie back with feet planted and grip the bar just outside shoulder width.
Set your shoulder blades against the pad, brace your trunk and bring the bar over your shoulders.
Lower the bar smoothly to your upper chest while keeping your wrists stacked over your elbows.
Press the bar straight back up over your shoulders until your arms extend fully.
tips: Keep your hips and upper back pressed firmly against the bench instead of overarching.
Angle your elbows roughly 45 degrees from your torso rather than flaring them straight out.
